name: Plantar Fasciitis / Plantar Heel Pain
definition: Mechanical plantar heel pain associated with plantar fascia degeneration/overload, typically causing first-step pain after rest and tenderness near the medial calcaneal tubercle.

typical: Pain after prolonged sitting then standing
Symptoms may ease after warming up then recur with load

redFlags.item: Acute inability to bear weight after trauma
Neurological deficit or severe night pain

investigations.MRI: Ultrasound/MRI may be used when atypical or refractory symptoms suggest alternative pathology.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs may identify fracture or other bony disease but heel spurs do not establish diagnosis.

green: Load modification and progressive plantar fascia/calf rehabilitation
amber: Injection and other procedures require individualized risk/benefit review; repeated corticosteroid injection carries tissue risk.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vatakantaka is a commonly considered Ayurvedic correlation for plantar heel pain.

patientEducation.summary: Mechanical plantar heel pain associated with plantar fascia degeneration/overload, typically causing first-step pain after rest and tenderness near the medial calcaneal tubercle.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
